name: Baked Ziti with Spinach and Ricotta

components.name: Baked Ziti
steps: Heat the oven to 190 C. Boil the measured dry pasta 2 minutes less than its packet instruction; drain, noting it will finish cooking in the oven.
Heat olive oil in a skillet; saute onion and garlic, add passata and herbs and simmer 10 minutes.
Wilt spinach in a separate pan and squeeze dry; fold it through ricotta with beaten egg and half the hard cheese.
Mix pasta with tomato sauce, layer in an oven dish with spinach ricotta, and finish with mozzarella and remaining hard cheese.
Bake uncovered 25-30 minutes until bubbling and the egg binder is fully set; rest 10 minutes before slicing into six portions.
Freeze cooled portions tightly wrapped; thaw in the fridge and reheat with a spoon of water to prevent dry pasta.
